criterio: Motivos contrastados con los textos alternativos del catálogo y prompts del historial. Variación de motivos, paleta, escala, tipografía, alineación y composición.

seleccion.descripcion: Un casete violeta con una cinta naranja que se despliega sobre un fondo melocotón.
seleccion.composicion: A beautifully simplified VIOLET AUDIO CASSETTE, cropped large at lower-left, with one wide ORANGE magnetic tape ribbon unspooling into a graceful single arc across right, no knots or tiny mechanics. PEACH background. Title in deep burgundy enormous rounded serif at TOP LEFT, four irregular lines «Muchas vidas, / muchos / maestros», maestros extends right. Message at MIDDLE RIGHT following a straight vertical rectangular text block, dark violet bold narrow sans «Un psiquiatra relata / su experiencia con / recuerdos de / vidas pasadas», letters minimum70px. Cassette only has two simple spindle circles and a lavender label with no text. Flat screenprint drawing, clever bold cropped composition.

seleccion.descripcion: Una mano sencilla con una esponja amarilla limpia una mancha azul sobre fondo rosa intenso.
seleccion.composicion: A graphic hand from RIGHT with brown skin and simple mitten-like fingers uses a huge YELLOW SPONGE to wipe a single opaque dark blue ink smear, revealing a warm HOT PINK background. One confident broad sweeping diagonal mark, not a rainbow, no other objects. Title deep navy at BOTTOM LEFT in expressive heavy italic display letters, «Aprenda» smaller and «optimismo» enormous. Message TOP LEFT in white thick geometric sans in three lines «Cambia cómo interpretas / los fracasos y aprende / a perseverar», 72px. Sponge has only five irregular dark yellow pore shapes, no photo texture. Rich editorial drawing with negative space.

seleccion.descripcion: Dos bandas de velcro rojas se separan con claridad sobre un fondo azul celeste.
seleccion.composicion: Two thick broad RED VELCRO STRAPS one coming from upper-left and one from lower-right pulling apart in center, one bends back into a beautiful graphic curve. Teeth reduced to few flat dark red marks; no tiny texture. Clear SKY BLUE background with ivory accents. Title «LÍMITES» colossal dark wine narrow architectural sans centered horizontally at upper-middle, straps never obscure text. Message LOWER LEFT in dark blue heavy rounded serif, four spacious lines «Aprende a decir no / y a cuidar tus / responsabilidades», 75px. Art asymmetrically occupies upper-left and lower-right diagonal corners. No labels or other text, no border.

seleccion.descripcion: Un armadillo coral se abre y estira sus patas sobre azul eléctrico.
seleccion.composicion: An elegant ARMADILLO uncurls, an expressive long rounded coral body with plum curved shell bands and small lilac tail, tiny dot eye and simple snout; definitely illustrated not realistic, no fur or shine. ELECTRIC BLUE background. Figure crosses middle from left to right, slightly cropped. Title TOP RIGHT aligned right, flowing huge ivory high-contrast serif italic «Volver / al amor», generous letter shapes. Message bottom left in pale peach heavy square sans, three lines «Una mirada espiritual / para elegir el amor / frente al miedo», minimum76px. Beautiful sophisticated asymmetry with warm animal colors and cool background, no hearts, no flowers.

seleccion.descripcion: Una langosta bermellón despliega sus pinzas sobre fondo azul petróleo.
seleccion.composicion: A single gorgeous stylized LOBSTER with vermilion body, salmon claws and simple lilac segments sprawls diagonally across TEAL PETROLEUM background, shown from above. Flat bold editorial linework, exactly two large pincers, simple narrow legs in four coherent pairs, no realistic crustacean texture. Title BOTTOM in very bold IVORY squared slab serif «SIN / CONCIENCIA», SIN smaller right aligned over the long word. Message TOP LEFT in ivory condensed hand-drawn sans three strong lines «Cómo los psicópatas / manipulan y viven / sin sentir culpa», approximately78px. Lobster reaches near but doesn't overlap message. Striking limited coherent vivid palette, not cute smiling.

seleccion.descripcion: Un tapiz de bandas entrelazadas coral, turquesa y amarillo se abre como una historia sobre fondo ciruela.
seleccion.composicion: A handwoven TAPESTRY hangs cropped from the RIGHT edge, flat editorial illustration with broad interlacing strips of coral, turquoise and golden yellow forming an expressive irregular block with a few thick loose threads at bottom. Not a checkerboard, no geometric tiny pattern, not realistic textile texture. Deep PLUM background. Huge title on LEFT in warm pale yellow soft chunky handwritten lowercase with clearly readable accents: «Déjame / que te / cuente», occupies upper-left60%. Message BOTTOM across cover in IVORY bold serif, three lines «Cuentos para comprender / tus emociones y descubrir / tu propio camino»,75px minimum. Tapestry structure rich yet restrained, no objects hidden inside, no stars or plants.
